gold.user: User requests to retrieve the current dynamic modules registered in the Jira Cloud platform to check their status and configuration.
gold.ideal: Successful retrieval of dynamic modules with a 200 OK response, including a list of modules and their details.

gold.user: User submits a request to register a new dynamic module with specific properties to enhance the functionality of their Jira application.
gold.ideal: Successful registration of the dynamic module with a 201 Created response, confirming the module has been added.

gold.user: User wants to remove a previously registered dynamic module that is no longer needed in their Jira application.
gold.ideal: Successful removal of the dynamic module with a 204 No Content response, indicating the module has been deleted.
